newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Gardenia has debut with rising prices.
newsitem.headline: Gardenia has debut with rising prices.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian curtain factory Gardenia Rt started trading with prices surpassing the subscription price in its IPO, traders said.

Gardenia shares opened at 1,700 forints and traders said that at around noon bids and offers ranged between 1,750 and 1,800 forints. At 1005 GMT it traded at 1,740 forints but in an earlier part of trading it has hit 1,780 forints.
Traders expected Gardenia's price increase to continue, saying the buying side was stronger in shares of the company which is a strong exporter.
Two series of Gardenia shares were introduced to the bourse, with the first series entitling its holders for dividend after the whole 1996, while the latter one entitled for dividend only from 1997.
The latter series represents Gardenia stocks in the company's recent capital market transaction which contained the offer of 222,000 own shares and the issue of 222,000 new shares.
